sourceFindings.finding: The Palace Museum's Shengjiao technical study explicitly treats basic strokes, component combination, structural features, similar characters and same-character variants as study dimensions.
sourceFindings.effect: Component-family comparison remains valid as single-glyph research, while adjacency and phrase flow remain excluded.

sourceFindings.finding: Research on the inscription reports that repeated characters and even repeated components can vary materially in form.
sourceFindings.effect: Variation must be retained as evidence; no averaged radical template is permitted.

sourceFindings.finding: Scholarship discusses possible assembled/constructed glyphs in the compilation.
sourceFindings.effect: Anomalous component matches are tagged transmission-or-compilation-sensitive and cannot alone establish a Wang stable rule.

provisionalInvariants: 日 is not treated as a fixed rectangular module
host-glyph role can change its aspect ratio and vertical placement
internal white space must be evaluated relative to total host density
lower 心 must be judged as a support/release system for the upper mass rather than an isolated radical shape
left-side 立 in 端 must preserve identification while yielding width to the right component
口 participates in host compression and is not required to remain a closed square
turning strategy and enclosure openness must be compared across host roles
readable 知 skeleton must survive compression when embedded in 智
right mass must remain identifiable while balancing the narrow left 立
notYetStable: transferability to other 耑-family host glyphs

provisionalInvariants: negative-space preservation is mandatory when a dense upper body sits over 心
notYetStable: specific Wang handling of 慧 upper stack

promotionDecisions.reason: This pass expands the evidence graph but does not fabricate visual measurements that have not yet been bound to verified remote glyph instances.

nextGate.name: verified-component-instance-binding
nextGate.requirement: Bind expansion targets to verified remote glyph instances, beginning with 日 and 口 because they already have multiple host roles; promote only cross-host invariants that survive those comparisons.
